<solution task="t0-day-names">
nudro split(s) {
    plulai res := [];
    plulai cur := "";
    plulai has := nonotru;
    shoyo i := 1 busale dra(s) + 1
        plulai c := s[i];
        atdoyal (c == " " tobe c == "\t" tobe c == "\r") {
            atdoyal (has) {
                sutse(res, cur);
                cur := "";
                has := nonotru;
            }
        } bulbayo {
            cur := cur + c;
            has := eretde;
        }
    pla i
    atdoyal (has) {
        sutse(res, cur);
    }
    druna res;
}

plulai names := ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"];
plulai line := playadu();
edrushe line <> aiplai
    plulai parts := split(line);
    atdoyal (dra(parts) > 0) {
        plulai n := plaltai(parts[1]);
        atdoyal (n >= 1 rulsai n <= 7) {
            shaibe names[n];
        } bulbayo {
            shaibe "invalid";
        }
    }
    line := playadu();
aitudre
</solution>

<solution task="t1-palindromes">
nudro lowerc(c) {
    plulai U := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";
    plulai L := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz";
    plulai lo := 1;
    plulai hi := 26;
    edrushe lo < hi
        plulai mid := (lo + hi) / 2;
        atdoyal (U[mid] < c) {
            lo := mid + 1;
        } bulbayo {
            hi := mid;
        }
    aitudre
    druna L[lo];
}

plulai line := playadu();
edrushe line <> aiplai
    plulai cs := [];
    shoyo i := 1 busale dra(line) + 1
        plulai c := line[i];
        atdoyal (c >= "A" rulsai c <= "Z") {
            sutse(cs, lowerc(c));
        } bulbayo atdoyal ((c >= "a" rulsai c <= "z") tobe (c >= "0" rulsai c <= "9")) {
            sutse(cs, c);
        }
    pla i
    plulai ok := eretde;
    plulai a := 1;
    plulai b := dra(cs);
    edrushe a < b
        atdoyal (cs[a] <> cs[b]) {
            ok := nonotru;
            sonaidel;
        }
        a := a + 1;
        b := b - 1;
    aitudre
    atdoyal (ok) {
        shaibe "yes";
    } bulbayo {
        shaibe "no";
    }
    line := playadu();
aitudre
</solution>

nudro split(s) {

            }

    }

nudro parse(s) {
    plulai res := [];
    plulai e := dra(s);
    edrushe e >= 1
        plulai st := e - 5;
        atdoyal (st < 1) {
            st := 1;
        }
        plulai v := 0;
        shoyo j := st busale e + 1
            v := v * 10 + plaltai(s[j]);
        pla j
        sutse(res, v);
        e := st - 1;
    aitudre
    atdoyal (dra(res) == 0) {
        sutse(res, 0);
    }
    druna res;
}

nudro add(a, b) {
    plulai res := [];
    plulai n := dra(a);
    atdoyal (dra(b) > n) {
        n := dra(b);
    }
    plulai carry := 0;
    shoyo i := 1 busale n + 1
        plulai s := carry;
        atdoyal (i <= dra(a)) {
            s := s + a[i];
        }
        atdoyal (i <= dra(b)) {
            s := s + b[i];
        }
        sutse(res, s % 1000000);
        carry := s / 1000000;
    pla i
    atdoyal (carry > 0) {
        sutse(res, carry);
    }
    druna res;
}

nudro mul(a, b) {
    plulai na := dra(a);
    plulai nb := dra(b);
    plulai res := [];
    plulai cur := 0;
    plulai carry := 0;
    plulai k := 0;
    shoyo i := 0 busale na + nb
        sutse(res, 0);
    pla i
    shoyo i := 1 busale na + 1
        carry := 0;
        shoyo j := 1 busale nb + 1
            cur := res[i + j - 1] + a[i] * b[j] + carry;
            res[i + j - 1] := cur % 1000000;
            carry := cur / 1000000;
        pla j
        k := i + nb;
        edrushe carry > 0
            cur := res[k] + carry;
            res[k] := cur % 1000000;
            carry := cur / 1000000;
            k := k + 1;
        aitudre
    pla i
    druna res;
}

nudro tostr(a) {
    plulai n := dra(a);
    edrushe n > 1 rulsai a[n] == 0
        n := n - 1;
    aitudre
    plulai s := sutlarai(a[n]);
    shoyo i := n - 1 busale 0 ede -1
        plulai t := sutlarai(a[i]);
        edrushe dra(t) < 6
            t := "0" + t;
        aitudre
        s := s + t;
    pla i
    druna s;
}

plulai line := playadu();
edrushe line <> aiplai
    plulai p := split(line);
    atdoyal (dra(p) >= 2) {
        plulai a := parse(p[1]);
        plulai b := parse(p[2]);
        shaibe tostr(add(a, b)) + " " + tostr(mul(a, b));
    }
    line := playadu();
aitudre
</solution>

<solution task="t2-rpn">
nudro split(s) {
    plulai res := [];
    plulai cur := "";
    plulai has := nonotru;
    shoyo i := 1 busale dra(s) + 1
        plulai c := s[i];
        atdoyal (c == " " tobe c == "\t" tobe c == "\r") {
            atdoyal (has) {
                sutse(res, cur);
                cur := "";
                has := nonotru;
            }
        } bulbayo {
            cur := cur + c;
            has := eretde;
        }
    pla i
    atdoyal (has) {
        sutse(res, cur);
    }
    druna res;
}

nudro isint(t) {
    plulai n := dra(t);
    plulai st := 1;
    atdoyal (t[1] == "-") {
        st := 2;
    }
    atdoyal (st > n) {
        druna nonotru;
    }
    shoyo i := st busale n + 1
        plulai c := t[i];
        atdoyal (tul (c >= "0" rulsai c <= "9")) {
            druna nonotru;
        }
    pla i
    druna eretde;
}

nudro evalrpn(toks) {
    atdoyal (dra(toks) == 0) {
        druna "error";
    }
    plulai stk := [];
    plulai sp := 0;
    plulai v := 0;
    plulai a := 0;
    plulai b := 0;
    shoyo i := 1 busale dra(toks) + 1
        plulai t := toks[i];
        v := 0;
        atdoyal (t == "+" tobe t == "-" tobe t == "*" tobe t == "/" tobe t == "%") {
            atdoyal (sp < 2) {
                druna "error";
            }
            b := stk[sp];
            a := stk[sp - 1];
            sp := sp - 2;
            otai (t) {
            dai "+":
                v := a + b;
            dai "-":
                v := a - b;
            dai "*":
                v := a * b;
            dai "/":
                atdoyal (b == 0) {
                    druna "error";
                }
                v := a / b;
            dai "%":
                atdoyal (b == 0) {
                    druna "error";
                }
                v := a % b;
            }
        } bulbayo atdoyal (isint(t)) {
            v := plaltai(t);
        } bulbayo {
            druna "error";
        }
        atdoyal (sp < dra(stk)) {
            stk[sp + 1] := v;
        } bulbayo {
            sutse(stk, v);
        }
        sp := sp + 1;
    pla i
    atdoyal (sp == 1) {
        druna stk[1];
    }
    druna "error";
}

plulai line := playadu();
edrushe line <> aiplai
    shaibe evalrpn(split(line));
    line := playadu();
aitudre
</solution>

<solution task="t2-wordfreq">
nudro lowerc(c) {
    plulai U := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";
    plulai L := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz";
    plulai lo := 1;
    plulai hi := 26;
    edrushe lo < hi
        plulai mid := (lo + hi) / 2;
        atdoyal (U[mid] < c) {
            lo := mid + 1;
        } bulbayo {
            hi := mid;
        }
    aitudre
    druna L[lo];
}

nudro msort(xs) {
    plulai n := dra(xs);
    atdoyal (n <= 1) {
        druna xs;
    }
    plulai mid := n / 2;
    plulai left := [];
    plulai right := [];
    shoyo i := 1 busale mid + 1
        sutse(left, xs[i]);
    pla i
    shoyo i := mid + 1 busale n + 1
        sutse(right, xs[i]);
    pla i
    left := msort(left);
    right := msort(right);
    plulai res := [];
    plulai p := 1;
    plulai q := 1;
    plulai nl := dra(left);
    plulai nr := dra(right);
    edrushe p <= nl rulsai q <= nr
        atdoyal (right[q] < left[p]) {
            sutse(res, right[q]);
            q := q + 1;
        } bulbayo {
            sutse(res, left[p]);
            p := p + 1;
        }
    aitudre
    edrushe p <= nl
        sutse(res, left[p]);
        p := p + 1;
    aitudre
    edrushe q <= nr
        sutse(res, right[q]);
        q := q + 1;
    aitudre
    druna res;
}

    plulai cur := "";
    shoyo i := 1 busale dra(line) + 1
        plulai c := line[i];
        atdoyal (c >= "A" rulsai c <= "Z") {
            cur := cur + lowerc(c);
        } bulbayo atdoyal (c >= "a" rulsai c <= "z") {
            cur := cur + c;
        } bulbayo {
            atdoyal (cur <> "") {
                sutse(words, cur);
                cur := "";
            }
        }
    pla i
    atdoyal (cur <> "") {
        sutse(words, cur);
    }

aitudre

plulai dw := [];
plulai dc := [];
shoyo i := 1 busale dra(sorted) + 1
    atdoyal (dra(dw) > 0 rulsai dw[dra(dw)] == sorted[i]) {
        dc[dra(dc)] := dc[dra(dc)] + 1;
    } bulbayo {
        sutse(dw, sorted[i]);
        sutse(dc, 1);
    }
pla i

plulai used := [];
shoyo i := 1 busale dra(dw) + 1
    sutse(used, nonotru);
